subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_diode_bias_generator ib_sink vdd
M6 ib_sink ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_diode_bias_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M6 to establish the PMOS gate bias voltage ib_sink for the amplifier current source device M5.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt complementary_single_ended_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
M4 vo vin net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
.ends complementary_single_ended_ota_core
subcircuits.role_hint: Main single-ended complementary OTA signal-path core. NMOS devices M0/M1 and PMOS devices M3/M4 form complementary input transconductance paths driven by vip and vin, with vo as the single-ended output. M5 receives the PMOS bias ib_sink, while M2 is internally self-biased from net2 to provide the NMOS-side tail/current-control function.
